snippet.title: Moo Who? - Announcement Trailer | Make Animal Sounds to Hide!
snippet.description:
Moo Who? is a multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you and your friends hide by imitating animals using your own voices.

To avoid being caught by the Hunter, you'll need to make convincing animal sounds at regular intervals.

Wishlist Moo Who? on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4948000/Moo_Who/
